llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed code-refinement helper that scans project source code for quality issues and does not show hidden, destructive, or data-exfiltrating behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently match the stated purpose: reviewing code for duplication, efficiency, clean-code issues, architectural fit, and error handling.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms such as refactoring, algorithms, and craft, which could invoke the skill more often than intended, but the runtime instructions remain within code review and refactoring analysis.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instruction files and modules only, with no bundled executable scripts or install-time code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to read project files and run grep/find/wc-style local scans, which is proportionate for code refinement; one PR-review helper uses gh pr diff for read-only changed-file discovery.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It may create TodoWrite items or a user-requested report containing file paths and snippets, but there is no evidence of background persistence, privilege escalation, credential collection, deletion, or exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to inspect source code in the active project and possibly produce reports with code snippets. Review optional Night Market/Claude Code plugin integrations separately before enabling them, and keep generated reports private when working with proprietary code.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad triggers are a real activation-quality concern, but they do not introduce hidden access or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[static-scan] expected: Static evidence shows markdown-only artifacts and no executable components.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal was pending, so it was not used as a negative signal.
